content.text: kwie meta naitɨ tita hetsiena mɨtixuawe.
Kakaɨyari 'aixɨa kaniyurieni 'atahutarieka tukari hetsiena mieme mɨpatsiekakɨ,
'ana muka'uxipikɨ, naime yu'uximayatsika tiutinɨka muyuawi meta kwie kemɨtiutawewi.

content: 'Arani meta 'Ewa Kepauka Yawé Kakaɨyari muyuawi meta kwie mutiwewi,
'ana 'akuxi 'iteɨrite pɨtiumawekai pɨkatitinewekai tupiriyate. 'Ana 'akuxi wiyeri Yawé Kakaɨyari pɨkakuyuitɨwakai, 'ana 'akuxi 'apɨka'uyeikakai tewi mɨtita'uximayatakɨ.
Matsi kwiepa kaniti'ekekaitɨni 'aɨxi. Mɨkɨ naime kwie puyuniyakai.
Hikɨ Yawé Kakaɨyari tewi kaniutawewieni kwiekɨ. Tsurieyatsie 'ihɨtsieka tukari kanipitɨani mayenierenikɨ muta'iwenikɨ. 'Ana 'ayeyuritɨ tewi kanayani.
Yawé Kakaɨyari haraweri kaniutawewieni 'Ereni mɨrakutewatsie, tau manatineika hepatsie. Tewi mutawewi muwa katiniuhɨritɨani.

Yawé Kakaɨyari kanitinetɨani mɨtiwerekɨ naime xexuime 'iteɨrite witsitiuxuxuawereme 'aixɨa 'aneneme kwaiyari. Haraweri hixɨapa 'iteɨri tukari tiyupitɨwame kaniutinetɨani, xeimeta 'iteɨri putinetɨa mɨtimaikakɨ tita 'aixɨa mɨti'ane tita 'axamɨti'ane.
'Ereni payeneikakai hatuxame mariwetɨ pɨ'ipakai harawerita, manata nauka 'akiyarite puhapanekai pɨtihatuiyakai harawerita.
Mexɨakame pɨtitewakai Pitsuni, naitsarie puyehanekai Kawira mɨrakutewatsie hakewa huru maxuawekaitsie.
Huru 'aixɨa pɨ'ane 'iya kwieyaritsie mieme. Puxuaweta xetsina witsi'anetɨ, puxuaweta 'unitse teteyari mutuxa.
Hutarieka mieme haa pɨtitewakai Kikuni mɨkɨ Kutsi kwieyaritsie 'aurie kananakuneka naitsarie.
Hairieka mieme haa, Tikɨritsi pɨtitewakai mɨkɨ 'Atsiriya tserieta puyehane. Naurieka mieme 'Eupɨrate hatuxameyari pɨhɨkɨ.
Merikɨtsɨ Yawé Kakaɨyari tewi kaniuhɨritɨani haraweri 'Ereni mɨti'uximayakakɨ, mɨti'ɨwiyanikɨ.
Yawé Kakaɨyari kanihɨritɨani mɨpaɨ rehɨawetɨ: «Ketinekwaka naime 'ikwaxi harawerita mieme.
Peru mɨkɨ 'iteɨri xeikɨa, tewi xɨka 'itikwani 'ikwaxiyari mɨkɨ tewi pɨretimani tita 'aixɨa mɨti'ane tita 'axamɨti'ane, mɨkɨ 'iteɨri 'ikwaxiyari pepɨkakwaka. Mexɨka pe'itikwani, 'ana pepɨmɨni».
Hikɨta Yawé Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «'Aixɨa pɨka'ane, 'uki yuxaɨta muyeikanikɨ. Peiyehɨwa yuteɨtame. Nepitawewirieni 'iparewiwame hetsiena mieme».

Yawé Kakaɨyari katiniwarunetɨani 'ena kwiepa yunaime memɨte'awɨwawe meta yunaime yeutari, hikɨ Kakaɨyari 'uki hetsɨa kaniwa'atɨani muwatiterɨwakɨ yuxexuime. 'Uki kaniwarutiterɨwa yunaime kememɨteheupaɨme, hikɨ mɨpaɨ mepɨtematiwa.
Mɨpaɨ 'ana tewi kaniwarutiterɨwa yunaime keyupaɨmetɨ memɨtexɨawe memɨteyutewatsinɨa, yunaime memɨte'awɨwawe, yunaime yeutari. Matsi mɨkɨ nixewitɨ tewi parewiwameya yemekɨ pɨka'atɨa.
Hikɨ Yawé Kakaɨyari 'uki heukutɨaka, waɨkawa kutsukaku kaniwakuhana 'akieya, hutariekata waiyarieya kaneunani.
Mɨkɨ 'uki 'akieyakɨ, Yawé Kakaɨyari 'uka kaniutawewieni, hikɨ 'uki kani'atɨirieni.
'Arani 'uka xeiyatɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni:
Mɨpaɨ mɨtiuyɨkɨ, 'ayumieme 'uki kaniyupatamɨkɨ yupaapa yumaama wahetsɨa kaniyeyeimɨkɨ, yɨ'ɨya hamatɨa mekaniyutaxewirikuni meyunaki'erietɨ, xeiwaiyari mekanakɨnikuni.
Hikɨ 'uki meta 'uka mepumamawekai mepɨkayutetewiyakai.
